title: Stage-3 edit-benchmark aggregate report
description: The versioned per-arm aggregate emitted by edit_scorer.aggregate. The HEADLINE metric is the all-three-gates pass rate per arm -- behaviour AND convention AND blast -- and its DENOMINATOR is the PLANNED cell set (task x arm x repetition), never the observed one, so a cell that never ran cannot inflate a rate by leaving the denominator. Absent cells are enumerated under completeness, fail it, and are bucketed as missing_cell. The full behaviour x convention x blast matrix, the individual gate rates, the paired arm deltas and the process distributions ride alongside; failure buckets are reported separately because only patch_rejected is evidence the agent was wrong. Deterministic and byte-stable: cells, reasons and arms are sorted before emit.

grouped_by.description: Compatibility fields the caller explicitly opted into mixing.

compatibility.description: The shared (or explicitly grouped) model / forge_version / task_bank_version values.

headline.description: The single number this benchmark reports.

complete.description: Mirrors completeness.passed. FALSE means the rates below are computed over a planned cell set that was not fully observed -- the headline is not trustworthy as a comparison.

arms.description: Arm name -> headline rate over PLANNED cells.

planned.description: Planned cells for this arm -- the denominator.

observed.description: Planned cells that actually produced a record.

all_pass.description: Cells where behaviour AND convention AND blast all passed.

rate.description: all_pass / planned; null only when planned is 0.

completeness.description: Criterion 2: every planned cell must be observed. Absent cells are reported, never dropped.

passed.description: True only when missing is empty AND unplanned is empty.

missing.description: Planned cells with no record, sorted by (task_id, arm, seed).

unplanned.description: Observed cells absent from the plan -- a drifted plan or a stray record; fails completeness rather than being folded into a rate.

pairing.description: Exact (task_id, seed) pairs observed across both arms; deltas are computed over these.

deltas.description: Treatment-minus-baseline over PAIRED cells. Empty when an arm is absent; a member is null when either side lacks the metric.

gates.description: Per-gate rates, each over PLANNED cells like the headline.

matrix.description: The eight-cell behaviour x convention x blast pass matrix over OBSERVED cells; keys are ordered behavior, convention, blast. All eight keys are always present (zero-filled). Sums to observed; the missing_cells shortfall lives in completeness.

failure_reasons.description: Failure buckets over PLANNED cells; all keys always present (zero-filled). all_pass + the sum of these equals planned. Kept distinct because they support opposite conclusions -- only patch_rejected is evidence the agent was wrong.

judged.description: Cells where this gate actually rendered a verdict; unjudged cells still count against the rate (fail closed).

rate.description: passed / planned; null only when planned is 0.
